The chart does not provide the absolute value for the TLDR bar in the MATH500 category. The value '1845' is fabricated. The chart only indicates a -31% reduction from the Vanilla CoT value of 2951.
The chart does not provide the absolute value for the TLDR bar in the AIME category. The value '6417' is fabricated. The chart only indicates a -4% reduction from the Vanilla CoT value of 6701.
The chart does not provide the absolute value for the TLDR bar in the AMC category. The value '3850' is fabricated. The chart only indicates a -16% reduction from the Vanilla CoT value of 4584.
